text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 2.7 days of methylprednisolone acetate 20 mg/mL 5 mL vial (NDC 00009027401). Corvale General holds 22.8 days. The rule‑ranked transfer moves 61 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with 14 days and the receiver with 13 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 5.9 days of the 40 mg/mL 5 mL vial and 8 days of 4 mg tablets. Other strengths and dosage forms are available at each site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list for methylprednisolone acetate injection shows the shortage as Current with an initial posting date of 2021-12-15 and lists Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Eugia US LLC, Par Health USA LLC, Pfizer Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals as affected companies. FDA inspection 1208260 at the Pharmacia & Upjohn plant (FEI 1810189) ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-09-10, 548 days after the shortage was first posted.

Our position: The 20 mg/mL 5 mL vial at Corvale East is critically low. Internal transfers are the highest‑ranked mitigation under current allocation rules and can be executed immediately. Caplin Steriles Limited is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place; it remains a secondary option.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 61 vials of 20 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 5 vials of 40 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside.
3. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 12 tablets of 4 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside.
4. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 8 tablets of 4 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside.
5. Buyer evaluates Caplin Steriles Limited only if transfers cannot meet needs.

Not recommended: No clinical substitutions or dose changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
